title: Culture and travel — core set
titleVi: Văn hoá và du lịch — bộ từ cốt lõi
description: Từ vựng để bàn về bảo tồn di sản, tác động của du lịch đại chúng và giá trị văn hoá bản địa. Đây là nhóm từ giúp bài viết về du lịch có chiều sâu thay vì chỉ khen cảnh đẹp.
ieltsUse: Dùng cho Task 2 các đề về du lịch, bảo tồn di sản, toàn cầu hoá văn hoá; cũng dùng được cho Task 1 khi mô tả lượng khách quốc tế.

words.def: traditions and buildings passed down from earlier generations
words.example: Preserving national heritage should remain a priority even in times of economic hardship.

words.def: the business of providing services for people travelling on holiday
words.example: Tourism generates a significant share of foreign currency in many developing economies.

words.def: tourism designed to protect nature and support local communities
words.example: Eco-tourism can fund conservation provided that visitor numbers are capped.

words.vi: tình trạng quá tải du khách
words.def: excessive numbers of visitors damaging a destination
words.example: Overtourism has forced historic cities such as Venice to limit cruise arrivals.

words.vi: bản địa, thuộc dân cư gốc
words.def: belonging to the original inhabitants of a place
words.example: Indigenous communities often lose land when tourism developments expand.

words.def: relating to ancestors or previous generations
words.example: Many rural families still perform ancestral rituals during the spring festival.

words.def: an object made by people in the past
words.example: Museums should return looted artefacts to the countries they were taken from.

words.def: the act of keeping something in good condition
words.example: Preservation of old temples requires both funding and specialist skills.

words.def: the work of repairing something to its original condition
words.example: The restoration of the colonial quarter attracted both tourists and investors.

words.vi: di sản thế giới (được UNESCO công nhận)
words.def: a place listed by UNESCO as having outstanding universal value
words.example: Becoming a world heritage site can boost visitor numbers almost overnight.

words.def: the process by which a minority group adopts the dominant culture
words.example: Rapid cultural assimilation can erase minority languages within two generations.

words.vi: hình thức ở trọ tại nhà dân
words.def: a stay with a local family, arranged for travellers
words.example: Homestays give visitors a genuine insight into everyday village life.

words.def: a planned route or schedule for a journey
words.example: A tightly packed itinerary leaves tourists exhausted and local sites overcrowded.

words.vi: xa khu du lịch đông đúc, ít người biết đến
words.def: far away from popular tourist routes
words.example: Promoting destinations off the beaten track can spread tourist revenue more evenly.

words.def: an object bought to remember a place or event
words.example: Cheap souvenirs made in factories abroad undermine local craft traditions.

words.def: a journey to a sacred place for religious reasons
words.example: Every year millions of pilgrims make the pilgrimage to the mountain temple.

words.def: a skilled worker who makes things by hand
words.example: Supporting local artisans keeps traditional crafts alive in tourist towns.

words.def: the traditional stories and beliefs of a community
words.example: Folklore passed down orally is easily lost once young people leave the village.

words.def: the sharing of customs and ideas between different cultures
words.example: Student exchange programmes promote cultural exchange more effectively than short holidays.

words.def: the quality of being genuine rather than artificially created
words.example: Many travellers now value authenticity over luxury accommodation.

words.vi: cộng đồng người di cư sống ngoài quê hương
words.def: a community of people living outside their homeland
words.example: The Vietnamese diaspora sends home both money and cultural influence.

words.def: a short organised trip for pleasure
words.example: Day excursions to nearby villages can reduce pressure on the city centre.

words.def: a holiday with transport and accommodation booked together
words.example: Package holidays made foreign travel affordable for ordinary families.

words.vi: công trình biểu tượng của một nơi
words.def: a building or feature easily recognised as a symbol of a place
words.example: The cathedral remains the city's most visited landmark.

words.def: including people from several different cultures
words.example: London is a multicultural city where over three hundred languages are spoken.
